p: feareth the LORD: He means that reverent fear which is in the children of God, which causes them to delight only in the word of God.
Wealth and riches shall be in: The godly will have abundance and contentment, because their heart is satisfied in God alone.
upright there ariseth light in the: The faithful in all their adversities know that all will go well with them for God will be merciful and just.
lendeth: He shows what the fruit of mercy is, to lend freely and not for gain, and so to measure his doings that he may be able to help where need requires and not to bestow all on himself.
dispersed: The godly are not stingy, but distribute liberally, as the need of the poor requires and as his power is able.
horn shall be exalted with honour: His power and prosperous estate.
melt away: The blessings of God on his children will cause the wicked to die for envy.
